modes.actor: Default: centers each body independently in paired views, preserving readable body size as it travels. Tracking uses XZ position and fixed height to avoid camera bob.
modes.cat: Centers K0-Tech for inspecting its authored movement and target path.
modes.overview: Fits arena bounds, root/cat paths, obstacle extents and avatar height through the actual native-to-display transform.

mobile: Camera controls sit beside/below the stage in the sidebar, leaving actors unobscured on phones and desktop single-body views.
review_alignment: Selecting a single-lane camera view selects that same take for review/export.
comparison_note: Follow mode independently centers each subject. Use Whole arena to compare route shape and relative progress.
timeline: Durations and FPS come from the episode; catalog call counts and full export ranges update dynamically.
collision_display: Amber pillars mark external controller contact, red marks remaining root-proxy overlap. Whole-body collision freedom is not claimed. Cat/actor mutual avoidance is not implemented; closest native proxy gap is shown explicitly.
validation: Independent actor following in both paired lanes
Review/export side stays aligned with single-lane camera focus
Mobile toolbar moves below stage without body obstruction
40-second pursuit seek, cat interpolation after35seconds, marked GLB export and end stopping

cat_gait.clock: Cumulative native cat distance times canonical C08 display scale divided by source gait speed. Current body scale cancels because both fixture travel and cat geometry use it.
cat_gait.determinism: Paired cats have identical phases; scrubbing reproduces the pose.
cat_gait.limitation: Authored quadruped gait fixture; not neural quadruped generation, gait contact IK or full cat-body collision physics.
